Netarhat: The Unspoiled Magic of the "Queen of Chotanagpur"

Tired of the overcrowded mall roads and commercialized hill stations? If you’re yearning for a place where the clouds touch the pine tops and the only "traffic" is the sound of cascading waterfalls, then welcome to Netarhat. Perched at an elevation of 1,128 meters in the Latehar district of Jharkhand, Netarhat is affectionately known as the "Queen of Chotanagpur." It is a land of raw beauty, colonial echoes, and a tranquility that is increasingly hard to find in 2026.

Why is Netarhat Called the Queen of Chotanagpur ?

Netarhat is blessed with lush green forests, rolling hills, scenic valleys, and mesmerizing viewpoints. Its refreshing weather and untouched beauty make it one of the most attractive hill stations in eastern India. Because of its royal beauty and charm, it is lovingly called the Queen of Chotanagpur.

Best Places to Visit in Netarhat

1. Magnolia Sunset Point : One of the most famous attractions in Netarhat, Magnolia Point offers a magical sunset view. Watching the sun slowly disappear behind the hills is an unforgettable experience.

2. Netarhat Sunrise Point : Start your morning with a beautiful sunrise over the hills and forests. The golden light spreading across the valley creates a stunning scene.

3. Upper Ghaghri Waterfall : A peaceful waterfall surrounded by greenery, perfect for photography and nature lovers.

4. Lower Ghaghri Waterfall : Another scenic waterfall where visitors can enjoy the sound of flowing water and fresh natural air.

5. Koel View Point : A scenic viewpoint where you can see the Koel River flowing through the valley.

Best Time to Visit Netarhat

The best time to visit Netarhat is from October to March when the weather is cool and pleasant. Monsoon season also makes the place greener and more beautiful.

How to Reach Netarhat

  • By Road: Netarhat is well connected by road from Ranchi, Daltonganj, and Latehar.
  • By Train: The nearest railway station is Latehar.
  • By Air: The nearest airport is Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi.

Things to Do in Netarhat

  • Watch sunrise and sunset
  • Explore waterfalls
  • Nature photography
  • Relax in peaceful surroundings
  • Road trip through forest routes

Food to Eat in Netarhat

While visiting Netarhat, you can enjoy simple, fresh, and local Jharkhand flavors. Some popular foods to try are:

1. Dhuska : A famous Jharkhand dish made from rice and lentils, deep-fried and served with spicy curry.

2. Litti Chokha : Roasted wheat balls stuffed with sattu, served with mashed potato and tomato chutney.

3. Rugra : A seasonal forest mushroom delicacy popular in Jharkhand.

4. Pitha : Traditional homemade rice flour dish, sweet or savory.

5. Thekua : A crunchy sweet snack made with wheat flour and jaggery.

6. Local Chicken Curry : Spicy village-style chicken curry with rice or roti.

7. Chai with Pakora : Perfect snack to enjoy in the cool weather of Netarhat.

Why You Should Visit Netarhat

Netarhat is perfect for travelers who love nature, silence, and scenic beauty. Unlike crowded tourist spots, it offers a calm and refreshing experience. It is one of Jharkhand’s hidden gems that deserves more attention.
excerpt: Netarhat, known as the Queen of Chotanagpur, is a beautiful hill station in Jharkhand famous for its cool climate, green forests, sunrise views, and peaceful atmosphere. It is a perfect destination for nature lovers and travelers seeking calmness.
